title: Another excellent kitchen tool from Oxo
text:
Another excellent kitchen tool from Oxo. I own close to two dozen OXO kitchen products, from the can't-live-without-it [[ASIN:B0000CCY1Y OXO Good Grips 3-Piece Angled Measuring Cup Set]] to single-use items that don't see much daily use ([[ASIN:B000AREB5S OXO Good Grips Mango Splitter]]). I own a couple of other OXO whisks, but this is my first OXO silicone whisk.

As I cook and bake several times a week, good whisks are important for me. The silicone coating is heat-resistant up to 600 degrees, so it can be used on pans taken straight from the oven, and is safe on Teflon and other nonstick coatings. As with other OXO products, the nonslip handle makes it easy to grab, even with wet hands. The wires are flexible enough to mix thick batters effectively, but sturdy enough that they don't lose their shape (I've owned several whisks with wires so bendable that they practically folded flat as soon as you went to use them). And it's dishwasher-safe, so I just throw it into the dishwasher when I'm done.

In short, this is another winner from OXO that I find myself reaching for on a regular basis. If you don't mind paying a little extra, I highly recommend my all-time favorite silicone balloon whisk, [[ASIN:B0000DHGE5 Le Creuset 10-Inch Silicone Balloon Whisk, Cherry]] (which was still made in the USA the last time I purchased one), but for the price, the OXO silicone balloon whisk does a fine job and is super-easy to clean.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips 11-Inch Silicone Balloon Whisk - Red
features: Silicone wires are perfect for whisking, blending and deglazing in coated and non-stick cookware and bakeware
Innovative handle shape fits comfortably in the palm of your hand
Silicone head is high heat resistant
description: The 11" Silicone Balloon Whisk features heat-resistant silicone and a soft, non-slip, teardrop-shaped handle that fits comfortably in the palm of your hand. The Silicone won't discolor, warp or melt, and is safe for non-stick, ceramic and metal cookware.
